cuda-16gb.stack: Official ComfyUI text-to-video template, unmodified defaults and the same seed as the MPS attempt (1280x720 requested, 1280x704 emitted, 5 s, 24 fps, prompt-enhance on). ComfyUI 0.33.0, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130, flags --lowvram --disable-smart-memory.
cuda-16gb.note: Completed in 95.25 s and produced a 5.04 s clip with a synchronized AAC audio track. Cleared aten::_int_mm, the exact op that killed the MPS run, because CUDA implements it. Offload is load-bearing: the transformer alone is 21.5 GB against 16 GB of VRAM, and the log reports 'DynamicVRAM support detected and enabled' plus comfy-aimdo NVML pressure. A mid-run nvidia-smi sample showed 9394 MiB in use at 95% utilization; that is a single sample, not a measured peak, so it is not recorded in the vram column.

mps-64gb.stack: Official ComfyUI text-to-video template, unmodified defaults (1280×720, 5 s, 24 fps, prompt-enhance on). ComfyUI 0.32.0, PyTorch 2.13.0, flags --force-fp16 --lowvram --use-pytorch-cross-attention.

failure.error_verbatim:
NotImplementedError: The operator 'aten::_int_mm' is not currently implemented
for the MPS device.
failure.when: Text encoder loaded, prompt enhancer finished (600 tokens @ ~7 it/s), transformer loaded, died before the first diffusion step.
failure.root_cause: The recorded PyTorch 2.13.0 MPS run failed at aten::_int_mm. This establishes failure for that stack and weight build; newer runtimes and alternative quantizations have not been retested in this log.

throughput.note: Vendor headline: 6.8 s to produce a 10 s clip on two NVIDIA GB200s. Datacenter hardware, not a consumer card. Not a quality score.
Prompt executed in 242.59 seconds. Zero seconds of video were produced.

throughput.hardware: RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16 GB (CUDA), 128 GB system RAM
throughput.steps: 3 sampling steps, 13.7 s of sampling (4.57 s/it)
throughput.note: Recorded prompt execution: 95.25 seconds end to end, with 50.1 GB of loaded weights reported for this CUDA run. Sampling took 13.7 seconds; the remainder includes loading and decoding. Loaded weight size is not the same quantity as the Mac run’s reported download total. Raw run receipts are not attached.
